plan.counting_rule: every joint-driver episode launch is booked, including failures, smoke starts and early terminations; synthetic unit tests -- including the ones that step the real timemap environment on hand-built maps -- are not episode launches and produce no experimental evidence
plan.hard_gate: B1 passivity and the detection-correctness verdict gate the S1 matrix (protocol revision R1): with either failing, no search-side effect number is produced at all

b1.purpose: B1 probe on/off x two candidate seeds x two repeats (passivity gate)

data.purpose: formal comparison: 60 new paired seeds x two arms

repro.purpose: ten historical miss seeds replayed + four registered no-miss controls

smoke.purpose: S1 interface, repeatability and configuration checks (simulation included)

reserve_may_not_be_used_for: converting the formal matrix into an open debugging budget

unit_statement.batch: undetected goals per batch of 60 episodes (个/批)
unit_statement.primary: undetected goals per episode (个/episode), denominator 60 episodes
unit_statement.task_level: on-time completed tasks per episode (个/episode); different denominator from goal counts, never added to them
